candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on the Hindi consonant 'ज' (ja) and words or subword tokens containing it.
This vector activates for common Hindi vowel matras, often followed by punctuation marks.
This feature vector represents common Hindi sub-word tokens and character fragments.
This vector represents characters, subwords, and words from the Devanagari script used for languages like Hindi and Sanskrit.
This vector represents common Hindi verbal roots and inflectional stems.
This feature vector activates on character n-grams and suffixes commonly found in Hindi words and their transliterations.
This vector represents Hindi character and vowel sign components used in Devanagari script encoding.
This feature vector activates on common Hindi words, suffixes, and character combinations.
This feature vector represents the numerical concept of the number 170s.
This feature vector activates on subwords and fragments of Hindi words written in the Devanagari script.
